title: Award Winning Las Vegas-Style Magic Show! Charles Bach Wonders!
blurb:
Experience Myrtle Beach's biggest award-winning Las Vegas-style magic and illusion show! Winner of Best Live Entertainment, Best Magician, and multiple Best of the Beach awards, Charles Bach Wonders! features spectacular grand illusions, comedy, audience participation, breathtaking visual effects, professional dancers, and Broadway-quality production in one unforgettable live experience.

Located at Wonders Theatre in the heart of Broadway at the Beach, you'll experience world-class illusions just feet away in an intimate theater where every seat offers an incredible view.

International illusionist Charles Bach has performed in 55 countries, starred for years at Caesars Palace Las Vegas, appeared on Penn & Teller: Fool Us, and performed at Hollywood's world-famous Magic Castle.

Perfect for families, couples, and visitors of all ages. Your tickets will be waiting at the Wonders Theatre box office when you arrive—no advance pickup required.
